en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large central square with a fountain in the middle, bordered by grand historic buildings. On the right is a long Baroque church or monastery with a tall tower topped by an onion dome; to its left stands an ornate multi‑storey corner building with elaborate façades and a pointed spire. The reverse side is printed with lines for address and the heading "România – Cartă Postală" along with the locality "Sibiu / Hermannstadt – Nagyszeben" and publisher details.
